parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat of the folding chair is a flat surface made of durable plastic, designed to support the user's weight comfortably.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main sitting surface for the user and is connected to the folding mechanism of the chair.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot upward or downward when folding or unfolding the chair, but remains stationary during use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the folding chair consists of the frame and legs, made of steel for structural strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and backrest, providing the main structural integrity and enabling the folding mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It folds and unfolds through pivot joints, allowing the chair to collapse for storage or expand for use.
